source_note: 以西侧完整实拍核对经幢的八角长幢身、层叠台座及上部华盖。经文不摹写，风化浮雕仅作轮廓概括，现代金属围栏及校园背景移除。JPEG原参考含MPO多图信息，实际生成输入为无损转存的RGB PNG。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, the Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant delicate slightly organic thin lines, sparse restrained detail and generous blank areas. Image 2 is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: the actual Tang dharani pillar in Songjiang, Shanghai, built in 859. Preserve this stone pillar's identifying silhouette, proportions and existing weathered parts.
Draw the COMPLETE tall single stone dharani pillar, centered, in a near-front elevation with very little perspective, vertical shaft vertical. Its long octagonal inscribed shaft occupies the middle. Below it, a low polygonal plinth supports several sculpted round and octagonal stone lotus/wave relief bases alternating with short waist drums, and an octagonal stone miniature railing platform immediately below the tall shaft. Above the shaft, retain the actual layered carved caps, beaded rounded drum, lotus forms, small octagonal waist eave, short dragon-carved cylinder and small low polygonal cap in exactly the photo's order. Do not invent a pagoda spire, metal finial, extra pavilion or umbrella; it is a carved stone column, not a multi-storey tower. Selectively suggest weathered relief with a few contours. Do not reproduce any inscription characters.
Use confident fine BLACK INK contours on perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF. All unmarked surfaces, inside and outside, pure white. Sparse internal lines, no filled shadows, grey shading, hatching, pencil grain, paper texture, gradient, color, halo, cast shadow or checkerboard. Remove school buildings, trees, metal fence, modern surroundings, plants, people, wires and signage. Keep the original stone miniature railing, not the modern perimeter fence. Only a few short ground contours.
Portrait 1024×1536 canvas. Whole pillar from top cap to bottom plinth occupies about 82% of canvas height. Balanced clear margins, top and base uncut. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border. White canvas will be removed by a local script.
